messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: service=redwood-inference-api v2.18 -> v2.19, canary=7% across us/* and eu/*; changelog: https://internal/release/2.19 :sparkles:
nora: Change-window confirmed 03:00-03:30 UTC. tagging platform_oncall for infra watch.
jamal: Quick metric check: slight increase in model latency p95 (~120ms -> 160ms) in eu-west ~+4m into canary, not sure if noise. dashboard: https://telemetry/latency?since=10m
yuki: I see a correlated CPU steal spike on a couple of inference hosts in eu-west. drifts look infra-related.
platform_oncall: Can we isolate eu-west from canary to avoid widening impact? We can region-pin back to v2.18 while keeping other regions at 7%.
nora: Yes we can do a regional pin. Who will run it? Also let's lower canary increment automation until we confirm.
jamal: I'll approve. rachel, can you execute the pin and add a short note to release doc?
rachel: Running commands now:
```
# pin eu-west to previous version and pause auto-increments
deployctl rollout region-pin --service redwood-inference-api --region eu-west --version v2.18 --reason "latency/cpu-steal" --now
deployctl auto-advance set --service redwood-inference-api --state paused
```
deploy-bot: Action executed: region-pin (eu-west) by rachel at 1820010018. Auto-advance set to paused.
jamal: Approved. Thanks rachel.
yuki: After pin, eu-west p95 returned to previous levels. CPU-steal traces saved to incident: https://incidents/182001.
platform_oncall: We'll investigate host scheduler and noisy-neighbor. If infra is clear, re-include eu-west with `deployctl rollout include-region --service redwood-inference-api --region eu-west --version v2.19` (owner approval required).
nora: rachel, can you add a known-issue blurb to release notes and mark v2.19 as blocked in eu-west until infra signoff?
rachel: Done. Release notes updated and block flag set.
jamal: For audit, recording regional rollback command: `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.18 --scope region:eu-west`
deploy-bot: Canary paused by system at 1820010040. Current: global 7% with eu-west pinned to v2.18.
nora: Thanks team. Holdcall placed; will reconvene after infra posts findings. Posting summary to #incidents. :white_check_mark:
